name: River Callahan
habitat: No fixed location — travels throughout GLMZ
origin: Tessera courier android, Model TC-2, manufactured 2046. Chose name 2058.
description: River Callahan was a courier for twelve years — the oldest android to receive personhood in the first Amendment wave. They chose 'River' because rivers go everywhere and belong nowhere, and 'Callahan' because it sounded like someone who'd been walking for a long time. River still walks. They walk every street, every corridor, every level of GLMZ, endlessly. They know the city better than any map because they've walked it all. They carry messages, small packages, and stories between communities that official communications don't connect. River is the Shelf's informal postal service, news network, and oral historian combined.
observed_behavior: Walks continuously through all districts. Carries messages and packages. Collects and shares stories. Has mapped every accessible space in GLMZ from personal observation. Never stays in one place for more than a day.
story_hooks: River discovers a section of GLMZ that isn't on any map — a space between buildings that shouldn't exist, maintained by infrastructure that isn't connected to any known system. River's walked every inch of this city. This is new.
